title: Choose the visual direction for Frigid Feet 50K
question: The roll assigned Polar Field Log for the mobile app. Compare it with Impeccable's Pick, the competitive Crouwel Grid challenger, or the category standard — or re-roll.

options.label: Polar Field Log
options.lineage: Arctic research station field logs & polar hydrographic charts
options.thesis: Daylight-legible polar expedition precision: crisp ice-sheet grounds, deep navy ink, and a live collective distance transect.
options.viewport: Top polar-navy shell with collective km distance transect (0-25-50-100 KM), 10-Round pill rail, chronological Runner lineup with right-aligned ETA bars, and a 52px gloved-thumb Finish/Start dock above 4-tab nav.
options.risk: Can feel slightly scientific if copy and celebratory milestone moments aren't kept warm and friendly.

raised.raise: Non-color tonal/pattern steps on every Leg state so sunlight glare never obscures status.
Right-aligned tabular elapsed time and ETA column for effortless mid-stride vertical scanning.
Crisp 1px geometric state detents on Round pills and 10-segment Team bars instead of soft shadows.
Compact proportional ETA progress bar inside each Out-on-Course Runner row.
High-salience active Round and sticky bottom thumb dock while completed/future Rounds step back.

options.label: Nordic Trail Wayfinding
options.lineage: Scandinavian cross-country ski trail (løype) signage & kilometer posts
options.thesis: Unmistakable winter trail clarity: cobalt-blue signage bands, snow-white cards, and numbered kilometer-post Round markers.
options.viewport: Cobalt signage header with collective km counter, numbered ski-post Round rail (R1-R10), crisp Runner status cards, and a high-vis bottom thumb dock anchored above the 4-tab bar.
options.risk: Also the direction most winter-outdoor runs land on — super effective, less unexpected.

options.label: Glacier Grid Specimen
options.lineage: Wim Crouwel gridded type specimens fused for winter outdoor telemetry
options.thesis: Ultra-crisp daylight typography on a faint ice-blue construction grid where monumental Round numbers and modular 50K cells read at arm's length.
options.viewport: Stark white viewport ruled by faint ice-blue gridlines, oversized tabular Round & km display, crisp modular Runner rows, and a bold cobalt primary action dock.
options.case: Holds product clarity strongly — huge high-contrast numerals excel in bright winter sun — while feeling more Swiss graphic design than cozy winter friend relay.
options.risk: Can feel stark or architectural if spacing and playful Badge accents are too rigid.

options.label: Exposure Record Zone Sheets
options.lineage: Darkroom printer exposure records & eleven-step zone ramps
options.thesis: Overlapping translucent zone sheets with hatched density marks.
options.viewport: Layered translucent darkroom cards with hatched load overlays.
options.case: Darkroom translucency and cross-hatching hurt winter sunlight readability and miss the warm friend-relay vibe.
options.risk: Unreadable in glare and visually noisy while jogging.
options.kept: Non-color tonal and pattern differentiation on every Leg state.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.lineage: Hand-lettered mixtape inlays ruled in ballpoint
options.thesis: Side A / Side B ruled tracklists timed to forty-five minutes.
options.viewport: Ruled handwritten tracklist split into two folded halves.
options.case: Handwritten nostalgia and two-side tape splits clash with a clean modern 10-Round outdoor app.
options.risk: Feels kitschy and cramped on a 390px phone screen.
options.kept: Right-aligned tabular elapsed time and ETA rhythm.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.lineage: Wide-margin print reference editions with a central key rail
options.thesis: Two narrow serif columns flanking a hairline vermilion key rail.
options.viewport: Twin narrow columns of roman serif with outboard marginalia.
options.case: Warm bone paper and dense bookish columns miss both the crisp winter atmosphere and mid-run glanceability.
options.risk: Too literary and fragile for gloved thumbs in bright sun.
options.kept: Crisp 1px geometric state detents on Round pills and Team bars.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.lineage: Vertical bilateral dance notation scores read bottom-to-top
options.thesis: A vertical center staff where block shape is direction and length is duration.
options.viewport: Bilateral vertical staff flowing upward with shaded movement blocks.
options.case: Bottom-to-top bilateral notation creates cognitive friction for a runner checking a phone mid-5K.
options.risk: Unfamiliar reading direction breaks instant comprehension.
options.kept: Proportional ETA progress bars inside active Runner rows.

options.label: Streaming Title Card Wall
options.lineage: Dark horizontal poster shelves with focus-expanding tiles
options.thesis: Horizontal poster rows where focused tiles expand and neighbors dim.
options.viewport: Dark horizontal carousels hiding metadata until focused.
options.case: Dark ground washes out in winter sun and hiding metadata behind focus interactions slows down race-day check-ins.
options.risk: Poor sunlight legibility and horizontal-scroll fatigue.
options.kept: Clear active-focus salience for the current Round and sticky thumb dock.

canonCard.label: The Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean, modern fitness utility: bright white surface, crisp slate typography, cool blue primary action, zero visual risk.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar top app bar, horizontal Round pills, clean white Runner cards, and a full-width blue primary CTA dock above 4-tab nav.
canonCard.risk: Immediately familiar, but indistinguishable from any generic running utility.
